name: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
site: Addenbrooke's Hospital (adult Type 1 ED; a separate paediatric ED operates on site - state which footprint each figure covers)
status: TEMPLATE - every value below is null until transcribed from the named publication. Null blocks are skipped by the product (the template assumption stays, and stays flagged). Never enter a number without recording its source and period. Note: CUH was a UEC field-testing site May 2019 - May 2023, so 4-hour data has a gap in that window; use recent months.

attendances_per_day.source: NHS England, A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions (monthly), provider-level CSV, row RGT: attendances for the period / days in the period. Record whether Type 1 only or all types. https://www.england.nhs.uk/statistics/statistical-work-areas/ae-waiting-times-and-activity/

four_hour_pct.note: VALIDATION TARGET, not a model input - goes in nhs_trust_snapshot.csv too.
four_hour_pct.source: Same NHSE monthly A&E publication, provider RGT: percentage within 4 hours (all types and Type 1 both published - record which).

twelve_hour_pct.note: VALIDATION TARGET, not a model input.
twelve_hour_pct.source: Same NHSE monthly A&E publication, provider RGT: 12-hour waits from decision to admit (and/or 12h from arrival, ECDS measure) as share of attendances.

hourly_shares.source: NHS Digital, Hospital Accident & Emergency Activity (ECDS-based, annual), 'attendances by time of arrival'. Use provider-level RGT if the open CSV carries it; otherwise the national Type 1 distribution and set granularity='national shape, trust volume'. https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/publications/statistical/hospital-accident--emergency-activity

acuity_mix_pct.source: Hospital A&E Activity (ECDS): attendances by acuity. Provider-level RGT if published; else national Type 1 shares, labelled as such.

ambulance_share.source: Hospital A&E Activity (ECDS): share of attendances arriving by ambulance, provider RGT. (The A&E Quality Indicators provider workbook also carries arrival-mode counts.)

admission_rate_by_acuity.source: Hospital A&E Activity (ECDS): admitted share by acuity. Provider-level if published; else national Type 1, labelled.

paediatric_share.note: Careful: Addenbrooke's runs a separate paediatric ED - only fill this if modelling the combined footprint.
paediatric_share.source: Hospital A&E Activity (ECDS): attendances by age band (share under 16), provider RGT.

mental_health_share.source: Hospital A&E Activity (ECDS): chief complaint / mental-health flag share if published at provider level; else leave null.

bed_occupancy.note: Goes in nhs_trust_snapshot.csv (bed_occupancy column) as a model INPUT.
bed_occupancy.source: NHS England Bed Availability and Occupancy (KH03 quarterly, overnight G&A), provider RGT; or the UEC/Winter Daily SitRep in season. https://www.england.nhs.uk/statistics/statistical-work-areas/bed-availability-and-occupancy/

inpatient_beds.note: Goes in nhs_trust_snapshot.csv (inpatient_beds column) as a model INPUT.
inpatient_beds.source: KH03 overnight G&A beds available, provider RGT (or the trust's annual report).

ambulance_handover_over_30_min_pct.note: Context/validation for the handover metrics - not yet a model input.
ambulance_handover_over_30_min_pct.source: NHS England Urgent and Emergency Care Daily Situation Reports (winter), ambulance handover delays by trust; or the Ambulance Quality Indicators (monthly).
